narrative.overview: A quiet native macOS instrument: two luminous material sculptures sit on graphite, with precise measurements and ruled traffic history below. The sculptures supply atmosphere; controls, text and charts stay restrained and legible. This captures the approved graphite/jade/copper direction as implemented in SwiftUI, rather than the earlier concept's approximate color values.
keyCharacteristics: Native window behavior and SF typography.
Jade for Codex or ChatGPT; copper for Claude Code.
Spacious primary visualization with compact supporting measurements.
Visible source, state and coverage information.

rules.name: The Client Color Rule
rules.body: Keep client identity separate from traffic direction: both receive and send use the client's color; line style and arrow direction distinguish them. Do not introduce blue controls.

dos: Do preserve the jade/copper identity mapping across all native surfaces.
Do distinguish baseline collection, unavailable data, inactive process, no visible connection, pause and collection errors with text.
Do keep source and coverage limits visible in every live panel.
Do use measured rates for animation and support reduced motion.
donts: Don't imply tokens, model thinking, costs or request counts from network bytes.
Don't draw activity particles for quiet or unavailable sources.
Don't replace native controls with blue accents or surround every reading with a card.
